svg.title: Prepare the TEM-grid specimen
svg.desc: Under ambient conditions, deposit droplets of an ethanol solution containing the nanocrystals onto carbon films supported by Cu grids. The source describes self-assembly on the grid during drying; drop amount, loading and drying time are unreported. Conceptual geometry; no measured apparatus design.

g.text: Source-bound concept; geometry is illustrative, not measured.
Qiu et al. 2006 · Supplied PDF pp. 2–3 · Exact locators in protocol
